subject: Gold Skulltula #85
text: In the Shadow Temple, Skulltula #85 is on the wall in a room with invisible spinning blades connected to the large open room.

evidence.quote: #85...Items: Longshot...Connected to the large open room is a room with invisible spinning blades...The Skulltula is on the wall here.

subject: Gold Skulltula #86
text: In the Shadow Temple, Skulltula #86 is located in one of the small alcoves in a room with two large panels with spikes that drop down.

evidence.quote: #86...Items: Longshot...Connected to the large open room is a room with two large panels with spikes...that drop down.  Find a Skulltula in one of the small alcoves.

subject: Gold Skulltula #87
text: In the Shadow Temple, Skulltula #87 is located behind a huge skull whose top is on fire.

evidence.quote: #87...Items: Longshot...There's a room with a huge skull that's top is on fire...The Skulltula is behind that skull.

subject: Gold Skulltula #88
text: In the Shadow Temple room with the giant boat, Skulltula #88 is found on the left corner of the room facing the front of the boat.

evidence.quote: #88...Items: Longshot...In the room with the giant boat, you can find this Skulltula on the left...Either Longshot it, or...use the Scarecrow Song to get over there.

subject: Gold Skulltula #89
text: In the Shadow Temple, Skulltula #89 is located behind three spinning skulls in a room reached after riding the boat and passing through the fire wall room.

evidence.quote: #89...Items: Longshot...After riding the boat, go through the room with fire walls....it leads to has three spinning skulls.  There is a Skulltula behind them.

subject: Gold Skulltula #90
text: At Gerudo Fortress at night, Skulltula #90 is on the furthest target at the archery range.

evidence.quote: #90...Items: Gerudo Membership Card, Longshot...Ride up to the archery range at the fortress and head to the furthest...target.  The Skulltula is on that target.

subject: Gold Skulltula #91
text: At Gerudo Fortress at night, Skulltula #91 is on the stone wall on the back of the fortress.

evidence.quote: #91...Items: Gerudo Membership Card, Longshot...This Skulltula is on the back of the fortress, on the stone wall.

subject: Gold Skulltula #92
text: In the Haunted Wasteland, Skulltula #92 is inside the stone structure with the Poe guide in plain sight.

evidence.quote: #92...Items: Longshot...Once you reach the stone structure with the Poe guide, head down inside it...The Skulltula will be in plain sight.

subject: Gold Skulltula #93
text: At Desert Colossus, dumping a bottle of bugs into the small dirt hole right by the entrance to the Spirit Temple forces Skulltula #93 out.

evidence.quote: #93...Items: Requiem of Spirit...Right by the entrance to the Spirit Temple is a small dirt hole...Bottle of Bugs onto the hole and they'll force the Skulltula out.

subject: Gold Skulltula #94
text: At Desert Colossus at night, Skulltula #94 is located in a tree near the empty desert oasis.

evidence.quote: #94...Items: Longshot, Lens of Truth...Near the empty desert oasis, you'll find a Skulltula in a nearby tree...Longshot it.

subject: Gold Skulltula #95
text: At Desert Colossus, planting a Magic Bean in the dirt hole in the past allows Link to ride the plant in the future and hop off near a rock to find Skulltula #95 at night.

evidence.quote: #95...Items: Requiem of Spirit...In the past, plant a Magic Bean in the dirt hole...Come back in the future...Hop off when it passes a rock to find a...Skulltula.

subject: Gold Skulltula #96
text: In the Spirit Temple First Floor in the past, Skulltula #96 is on a fence across a pit.

evidence.quote: #96...Location: First Floor...Items: Requiem of Spirit...One of the rooms in the temple has a pit and a fence on the other side of it...The Skulltula is on that...fence.

subject: Gold Skulltula #97
text: In the Spirit Temple, Skulltula #97 is found by turning around at the top of the climbable wall leading to the Second Floor in the Lizalfos area.

evidence.quote: #97...Location: Second Floor...Items: Requiem of Spirit...There's an area with Lizalfos and a climbable wall that leads to the second...At the top of this wall, turn around to find a Skulltula.

subject: Gold Skulltula #98
text: In the Spirit Temple Second Floor in the past, Skulltula #98 is located above and behind Link in the room leading to the Iron Knuckle battle.

evidence.quote: #98...Location: Second Floor...Items: Requiem of Spirit...Just before your battle, as a kid, with the Iron Knuckle, you can find a...Skulltula above and behind you in the room leading to it.

subject: Gold Skulltula #99
text: In the Spirit Temple First Floor in the future, playing the Song of Time moves a blue block in front of an alcove in the trench room with rolling rocks to claim Skulltula #99.

evidence.quote: #99...Location: First Floor...Items: Silver Gauntlets...There's a room that has rocks that roll back and forth in a trench, and...there's a blue block in front of one of the alcoves.  Play the Song of Time...to move that block and claim the Skulltula.

subject: Gold Skulltula #100
text: In the Spirit Temple Second Floor big statue room in the future, playing the Scarecrow Song at the top of the left staircase summons Pierre to the opposite ledge, allowing Link to Longshot across and claim Skulltula #100.

evidence.quote: #100...Location: Second Floor...Items: Silver Gauntlets, Scarecrow Song...In the big statue room, climb up the left staircase (left facing the statue)...play the Scarecrow Song and Pierre will appear at a ledge...opposite.  Longshot to him and claim the final Skulltula.
